title: Deliverable design standards (control parameters) — Issue 2.0
subtitle: Issue-1.0 parameters retained in full; Issue-2.0 additions follow

tiers.basic: Early idea or small business; entry-level clarity
tiers.standard: Active SME or team needing structure; stronger business use
tiers.premium: Founder, board, investor or lender preparing for serious review

tiers.basic: Priority issues only (about half the key-issue list, minimum 3)
tiers.standard: All key issues analysed in full
tiers.premium: All key issues + scenarios, benchmarks, roadmap, board summary
Senior + QA review (qualified partner where regulated)

tiers_v2.basic: 90-second personalised briefing or how-to video, EN + 1 local language, captioned
tiers_v2.standard: 3–4-minute branded briefing, chapters, up to 3 languages
tiers_v2.premium: 6–8-minute executive briefing by consented digital-twin presenter, lip-synced translation; interactive avatar Q&A for 90 days
tiers_v2.basis: Brief §3; HeyGen API (video generate, translation, streaming avatar)

tiers_v2.basic: 3–5 branded charts (TBCA brand kit) in PDF/PNG
tiers_v2.standard: Interactive report, 8–15 charts or maps, private link + PDF, engagement analytics
tiers_v2.premium: Live-data dashboard (data connection/SQL), 12-month hosted link, monthly refresh, PDF/PNG/HTML export
tiers_v2.basis: Brief §3; Infogram Business; Bible Infogram spec (OSS-S12/S15)

tiers_v2.parameter: AI analyst Q&A on the deliverable
tiers_v2.standard: 30 days, grounded only on the deliverable and its sources
tiers_v2.premium: 90 days, grounded; plus alerts on watched topics

tiers_v2.standard: 90-day plan with owners and WhatsApp nudges
tiers_v2.premium: 12-month tracker synced to the portal with monthly status

tiers_v2.standard: ≥ 1 peer set from the TBCA Data Bank

tiers_v2.basic: Automatic on EVT-006 Payment Confirmed; clock from intake completion

formats.consulting_standard: McKinsey SCR storyline + Pyramid Principle; action titles; MECE issue tree; every exhibit sourced (fact ID, date, grade)
Deloitte Digital design-system discipline: plug-and-play fields, guidance notes, worked example, version control
BCG hypothesis-driven analysis; 80/20 focus; 2x2 / matrix frameworks; so-what on every chart
IVS-aligned multi-method valuation; football-field reconciliation; explicit assumptions; not a regulated opinion
McKinsey executive-brief format: answer first, three supporting messages, evidence grades, "what this means for you"
McKinsey ghost-deck method: one message per slide, action titles, appendix for detail
Deloitte Digital human-centred design; KPI tree; mobile-first; RAG thresholds; data freshness stamp
Deloitte Digital toolkit standard: job-to-be-done, how-to guide, templates, checklists, examples
FAST modelling standard: separate inputs / calcs / outputs; checks sheet; scenario switch; model book
Deloitte Digital product standard: versioned, licensed, accessible, mobile-ready
Big-4 checklist convention: requirement, evidence, status, owner, red-flag rule
Transparent formula, labelled inputs, scenario toggle, assumptions log (FAST)
Controlled register: unique IDs, owner, status, date, evidence link, audit trail
Controlled record: reference, parties, evidence, approval, checksum
BCG roadmap convention: phases, gates, owners, KPIs, critical path
McKinsey decision memo: recommendation first, options, trade-offs, decision required
Cartographic standard: legend, scale, source and date per layer, evidence card per feature
Deloitte Digital service design: cadence promise, usage statement, longitudinal value; McKinsey brief format per cycle
BCG programme-management convention: allowance ledger, progress against KPIs, quarterly review
Native transaction-blueprint contract; EvidenceEvent per act (LAW 7)

csat_rules: Survey trigger: portal acceptance or 7 days after delivery, whichever first. Scale 1–5; CSAT = share of 4 and 5 scores.
Measurement unit: each deliverable × tier, rolling 90 days; minimum 10 responses before a breach is declared.
Breach: below the tier minimum → automatic root-cause review by QA within 5 business days and one free corrective revision for the client.
Two consecutive breaches → deliverable template frozen for re-design; family owner reports to the Head of Delivery.
Quality gates before release: named delivery owner, creation QA, human review sign-off, version control (live product page "Quality" block).
Issue 2.0: the CSAT survey is sent automatically by the aftercare loop (OSS-S16, LOOP-RATING: 3 nudges in 14 days); a breach also demotes the archetype to full human review (Bible recall rule).
